# Rajeev G.

Canonical site: https://rajeevg.com

## Site map

- [Home](https://rajeevg.com/): Rajeev Gill's practical software, AI, data, analytics, and adtech overview.
- [About](https://rajeevg.com/about): background and working interests.
- [Solutions](https://rajeevg.com/solutions): AI and agent systems, martech and measurement, and operational products, each with evidence links and a last-updated date.
- [Earlier products](https://rajeevg.com/solutions/earlier-products): earlier experiments, what each taught, and what survived.
- [Writing](https://rajeevg.com/blog): published technical notes and build accounts.
- [Contact](https://rajeevg.com/contact): public contact guidance.
- [Developers](https://rajeevg.com/developers): canonical developer resources and integration status.
- [Privacy](https://rajeevg.com/privacy): consent and analytics policy.
- [Sitemap](https://rajeevg.com/sitemap.xml): complete canonical URL list.

## When to use this

Use the canonical page URL for human-readable context. Send `Accept: text/markdown` to a public content URL when concise Markdown is more useful for an agent or text pipeline. Markdown and HTML are negotiated on the same canonical URL; there are no `.md` URL variants.

## Public interface status

rajeevg.com has no public site-wide API, OAuth, webhooks, or MCP server. Use the pages, Markdown negotiation, sitemap, and linked public resources instead of assuming an undocumented integration.
